platforms.sigma:
title: Registry Run Key Persistence From User-Writable Path
id: 7080b048-4dcb-5428-984f-56b6de11a5f7
status: experimental
description: 'Registry Run Key Persistence From User-Writable Path. Evidence basis: on disk under the victim''s privileges — including startup folders, PATH directories, or system locations. ### Deta. CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX Detection Engineering.'
references:
- 'https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-54550'
- 'https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-f63g-88cj-hjf9'
- 'https://github.com/izpack/izpack/security/advisories/GHSA-f63g-88cj-hjf9'
- 'https://github.com/izpack/izpack/pull/1193'
author: CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX Detection Engineering
date: 2026-08-26
tags:
- attack.t1547.001
logsource:
    product: windows
    category: registry_set
detection:
    selection:
        TargetObject|contains: \Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run
    filter_1:
        Image|startswith:
            - 'C:\Program Files'
            - 'C:\Windows\'
    condition: selection and not filter_1
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative activity
    - Authorized security testing
level: medium
platforms.kql:
DeviceRegistryEvents
| where RegistryKey contains "\\Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run"
| where not ((InitiatingProcessFolderPath startswith "C:\\Program Files" or InitiatingProcessFolderPath startswith "C:\\Windows\\"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, RegistryKey, RegistryValueData, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
platforms.splunk: | tstats count from datamodel=Endpoint where nodename=Endpoint.Registry Registry.registry_path="*\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run*" NOT (Registry.process_path="C:\Program Files*" OR Registry.process_path="C:\Windows\*") by Registry.process_path Registry.registry_path _time
platforms.osquery: SELECT * FROM registry WHERE path LIKE '%\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run%';
